listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to another method's case study in a tissue-paper plant (pulp & paper continuous production) cited in the literature review, not this paper's own application
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The validity and practicality of this method were veriﬁed using a
case study in a tissue-paper plant.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Melting furnace producing molten aluminium alloy as the first step of the die-casting process chain (part of a discrete die-casting operation, not primary continuous aluminium production)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
aluminum alloy blocks and rejected die-casting parts are put into
the melting furnace to obtain the molten metal which is then
shaped into semi-ﬁnished parts by the die-casting process.

one_line: The paper develops and demonstrates an Energy Value Mapping lean method in a die-casting plant producing automotive engine blocks (discrete metal-parts manufacturing), with only a citation-level mention of a tissue-paper plant and an in-process aluminium melting furnace.
